C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER.IntentSummary: Deliver one stable adaptive action center and universal immutable document intake router by composing existing feature launchers, deterministic worker/materializer results, rank-only preferences and safe meeting merge rules, then verify desktop/mobile, recovery and offline invariants.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: specify the universal action and document-intake path

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The flow defines entry points, exact document identity, deterministic routing, pending/failed/unknown/ambiguous states, partial success, explicit-context precedence and generic fallback without a confirmation wizard.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: define stable desktop and mobile hierarchy

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The center has one universal upload zone, fixed groups, exactly three recommendation slots, deterministic search, clear status text, keyboard/focus behavior and equivalent mobile completion without geometry learned from statistics.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: select restrained entry motion and reduced-motion behavior

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Only a short interruptible modal or bottom-sheet entry transition explains causality; routine actions have no decorative delay and prefers-reduced-motion leaves the full static state understandable.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve identity, provenance, idempotency and meeting truth

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Existing document/version, extraction run, plan, meeting, agenda, decision, review, calendar, search and ui preference data remain authoritative; exact IDs and evidence are retained; safe protocol merge never overwrites conflicting facts and requires no migration.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement registry, ranking, upload routing and launcher adapters

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The top-bar, keyboard and calendar-day entry points open the same center; actions use the registry and existing launchers; upload uses the normal immutable endpoint and opens the exact materialized object associated with the returned documentId.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently verify the rendered implementation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The actual implementation receives PASS only with no blocker or major finding for clarity, fixed geometry, focus, desktop/mobile, reduced motion, provenance, error preservation and exact-object routing.

T-007.Title: kafedra-tests: cover ranking, routing, merge, degraded mode and responsive workflow

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Tests prove explicit and domain context precedence over frequency, server allowlist rejection, fixed slots and groups, date preservation, exact documentId routing, multi-question protocol support, conflict preservation, idempotent retry, desktop/mobile focus and reduced motion.

T-008.Title: kafedra-release: verify unchanged schema, recovery and offline compatibility

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No migration, VERSION or runtime dependency is added; project, backup/restore, offline and release gates remain green on the exact implementation and post-merge heads.
